data.value: Use the archive to recover the missing before exposing anyone.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.isi-ending
data.value: Give Isi the choice over the records tied to her grove.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.burn-both
data.value: Burn both ledgers. Deny the Crown and the Stag the power of the list.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.bury-truth
data.value: Hide the true ledger and leave the official story intact.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.investigation-hub.Title
data.value: Four Threads

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.investigation-hub.Body
data.value: Greyhaven is small enough to cross in minutes and secretive enough to spend days inside. Each place feels aware of the others. You do not need every answer, but enough pieces may make the pattern impossible to deny.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-room.Title
data.value: Tomas's Room

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-room.Body
data.value: Nell leads you to a narrow room above a net-maker's shop. Tomas left in a hurry, but not randomly. Books lie open to shipping registers. A floorboard beside the bed has been lifted and put back badly.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-cache.Title
data.value: A Page Removed

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-cache.Body
data.value: Under the loose floorboard is a torn shipping ledger page. The vessel name SAINT MARROW survives at the top. Below it, several passenger names have been scraped away and rewritten in newer ink. The handwriting matches none of Tomas's notes.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-obvious.Title
data.value: The Same Four Families

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-obvious.Body
data.value: Even without finding a hidden cache, the open books tell you something. Tomas had circled the same four family names from his note again and again across seventy years of harbor records. Captain Varro's family appears most often.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.chapel-archive.Title
data.value: Saint Orra's Chapel

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.chapel-archive.Body
data.value: Father Rowan has already laid half the archive across the pews. Births, deaths, storms, wrecks. He points to a gap in the records: the entire winter of the Saint Marrow disaster was recopied twenty years later. The original book is supposedly lost.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.false-deaths.Title
data.value: Deaths without Bodies

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.false-deaths.Body
data.value: The copied register records eleven Saint Marrow passengers as 'lost to sea'. Older parish notation distinguishes bodies recovered from those never found. Here, someone deliberately erased that distinction. Eleven people were declared dead without saying whether Greyhaven ever found them.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.funeral-code.Title
data.value: Eleven Unfinished Rites

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.funeral-code.Body
data.value: The margin marks are not shipping shorthand but unfinished funeral rites. Eleven names were entered for prayers that were never completed. Someone began a memorial and then stopped it deliberately.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.rowan-crypt.Title
data.value: Under Saint Orra's

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.rowan-crypt.Body
data.value: Rowan unlocks a trapdoor behind the altar. Stone steps descend to the foundation of the older chapel. The air below smells of wet limestone. At the bottom, a bricked arch carries the same window shape Tomas drew.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.crypt-blocked.Title
data.value: A Wall for Later

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.crypt-blocked.Body
data.value: The foundation shifts under pressure. Rowan stops you before the ceiling joins it. Even sealed, the space gives up one detail: a bell-shaped recess in the floor where something heavy once stood.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.old-chapel.Title
data.value: The First Memorial

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.old-chapel.Body
data.value: Beyond the arch is a tiny chapel abandoned under the modern one. Eleven names have been scratched into the wall, then covered with limewash. Near them hangs a rusted iron key and a strip of blue ship's ribbon preserved behind wax.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lighthouse-path.Title
data.value: The Dead Light

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lighthouse-path.Body
data.value: The lighthouse path climbs through thorn and wet grass above a sheer drop. No keeper has lived here in thirty years. Halfway up, you find fresh boot prints going both directions. One set belongs to someone limping.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.elias-hut.Title
data.value: Elias Vane

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.elias-hut.Body
data.value: The tracks lead to a maintenance hut where Elias Vane, Greyhaven's last lighthouse keeper, sits beside a cold stove with a knife across his knees. He is seventy if a day and looks offended that the world has survived him. 'The tower is dead,' he says before you ask. 'The thing below it isn't.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.elias-truth.Title
data.value: The Light Was Put Out

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.elias-truth.Body
data.value: Elias inherited the keeper's private log from his grandfather. On the night Saint Marrow wrecked, Greyhaven's lighthouse did not fail in the storm. Men from the village extinguished it. Elias has spent his life protecting that page because his own family helped them afterward.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lighthouse-door.Title
data.value: The Sealed Tower

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lighthouse-door.Body
data.value: The tower door is chained from outside, but the chain is new. Someone wants the lighthouse to look abandoned while still controlling access. A narrow drainage arch disappears around the cliff side.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lighthouse-drain.Title
data.value: Salt beneath Stone

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lighthouse-drain.Body
data.value: The drainage arch is barely shoulder-wide and slick with salt. It does not lead into the tower. It slopes downward beneath it. Someone has recently widened the passage with tools.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lighthouse-inside.Title
data.value: A Lantern That Should Not Burn

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lighthouse-inside.Body
data.value: Dust covers the stairs, but the lantern room above is clean around one pane. A small blue alchemical lamp sits hidden behind the cracked lens — the light you saw last night. Its fuel line runs not to a reservoir but down through the floor toward the cliff.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lighthouse-mechanism.Title
data.value: A Signal, Not a Haunting

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lighthouse-mechanism.Body
data.value: The line joins a copper speaking tube descending into the rock. Someone has been using the abandoned lighthouse as a signal station. The supernatural bell is real, but at least one human hand has been working around it.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.warehouse-front.Title
data.value: Varro & Sons

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.warehouse-front.Body
data.value: Captain Varro's warehouse occupies the best stretch of quay. Two dockhands sit outside a locked office while others move crates despite the grounded fleet. A black raven is branded into several crate lids — not a Greyhaven mark.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.warehouse-alley.Title
data.value: Crates for a Dead Route

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.warehouse-alley.Body
data.value: From the alley you watch two workers carry provisions into a cart labeled for the lighthouse service — a service that has not existed in decades. The cart route climbs toward the cliff after dark.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.warehouse-office.Title
data.value: Captain's Ledger

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.warehouse-office.Body
data.value: Varro's office contains no confession, only numbers. But one ledger lists payments to 'maintenance below the light' and another records food for four people who do not exist on any crew list. A brass key on the desk is stamped with the same tide symbol as Saint Orra's old foundation.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.evidence-table.Title
data.value: The Shape of It

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.evidence-table.Body
data.value: Back at the Bent Anchor, you spread what you have across a corner table. Different routes point to the same conclusion: the lighthouse hides access to something below the cliff, Varro's people have been supplying it, and the Saint Marrow wreck was never the accident Greyhaven recorded.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-confrontation.Title
data.value: Captain Varro

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-confrontation.Body
data.value: Varro receives you in the harbor office without pretending surprise. He is neat, grey-haired and tired of being feared by people he considers smaller than himself. 'You have pieces,' he says. 'Pieces make dangerous confidence. If you want the rest, come to the Anchor tonight. Back room.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-cracks.Title
data.value: A Name He Did Not Mean to Say

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-cracks.Body
data.value: Varro's composure slips for one word: 'Marrow.' He corrects himself too late. He knows exactly what lies below the lighthouse. 'Back room,' he repeats, colder now. 'If you still want answers.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.games-in-lantern.Title
data.value: Act III — Games in the Lantern

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.games-in-lantern.Body
data.value: After midnight Mara unlocks a narrow door behind the pantry. The Bent Anchor's back room is older than the inn above it: green felt, whale-oil lamps, scarred wood and people who stop using surnames. Captain Varro waits at a Blackjack table. In the corner, old Bram Kestrel rattles five bone dice in a cup.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-offer.Title
data.value: One Hand for the Route

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-offer.Body
data.value: Varro places a folded chart beneath his palm. 'One hand. You win, you get the route my men use beneath the lighthouse. I win, you stop breaking into my property until dawn.' Mara deals neither side sympathy.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-blackjack.Title
data.value: The Captain's Hand

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-blackjack.Body
data.value: Varro cuts the deck once and slides it back across the felt. The room narrows to cards, breath and the soft tap of Mara's fingernail against the shoe.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-win.Title
data.value: A Captain Pays

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-win.Body
data.value: Varro studies the final hand, then pushes the folded chart to you. It shows a service tunnel from the lighthouse drain into a cavern called LOWER CHOIR. One note is underlined twice: PASSABLE ONLY BEFORE HIGH TIDE.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-loss.Title
data.value: The Captain Collects

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-loss.Body
data.value: Varro gathers the cards. 'A bargain is still a bargain when it hurts.' He will not hand over the chart, but as he folds it you glimpse enough coastline to recognize the lighthouse drain as its starting point.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-draw.Title
data.value: No Captain Wins a Push

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-draw.Body
data.value: Varro exhales through his nose. 'Again, or admit the sea has better judgment than either of us.' The chart stays under his hand.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-offer.Title
data.value: Bram's Bone Dice

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-offer.Body
data.value: Bram's beard reaches his vest and his eyes are much sharper than the rest of him. He places a rolled scrap of oilskin beside the dice cup. 'Tomas gave me this before he went under the cliff. Said Nell was to have it if he didn't return. I dislike sad deliveries. Beat my hand and you can make it yourself.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-dice.Title
data.value: Five Bones

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-dice.Body
data.value: Five bone dice tumble onto black felt. Bram taps two of them with a bent finger. 'Keep what you trust. Throw what you don't. Three rolls. Then the bones tell us which of us is lying to ourselves.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-win.Title
data.value: Tomas's Oilskin Map

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-win.Body
data.value: Bram slides the oilskin over without complaint. Tomas marked a chamber below the lighthouse with eleven short lines around a bell symbol. Beside it he wrote: THEY WANT TO MOVE IT BEFORE THE SPRING TIDE.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-gives-map.Title
data.value: A Wager Refused

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-gives-map.Body
data.value: Bram studies you for a long moment, then pushes the dice aside. 'Good. Tomas would have hated me making Nell pay for his stubbornness.' He gives you the oilskin map anyway and tells you the lowest tunnel floods first.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-loss.Title
data.value: The Bones Keep Their Secret

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-loss.Body
data.value: Bram banks a stronger hand and folds the oilskin away. But disappointment makes him careless: 'If you're going anyway, don't take the lowest tunnel after the third tide mark.' It is not the map, but it is enough to save time.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-draw.Title
data.value: Bones on Edge

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bram-draw.Body
data.value: The scores tie. Bram looks delighted. 'That is either fate or poor arithmetic. Again?'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.after-games.Title
data.value: Before the Tide Turns

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.after-games.Body
data.value: By the time you leave the back room, the next bell is less than two hours away. Nell is waiting in the public room with a coil of rope, a lantern and the expression of someone who has already decided she is coming with you.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.cliff-descent.Title
data.value: Act IV — Below the Tide

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.cliff-descent.Body
data.value: The lighthouse looms above as you descend the cliff path. The fog is thinner here, shredded by wind. Below, black water moves in and out of the rocks like breath. Every route you discovered points toward the drainage arch under the tower.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.service-tunnel.Title
data.value: The Smuggler's Stair

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.service-tunnel.Body
data.value: The brass key opens a disguised iron hatch. Beyond it, cut steps descend through the cliff. Crates, lamp oil and fresh boot marks prove Varro's people have used this route for years. One crate contains bandages and tonic rather than contraband.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.upper-cave.Title
data.value: Tomas's Upper Route

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.upper-cave.Body
data.value: Tomas's oilskin markings lead across a natural shelf above the flooded tunnel. Halfway across, you find his broken lantern and a strip of Nell's family-blue scarf tied to a rock. The knot points deeper in.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lower-choir.Title
data.value: The Lower Choir

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.lower-choir.Body
data.value: The drain opens into a vaulted cavern where each wave produces a different note. Old stonework lines the walls. Someone once built a chapel here, then the sea reclaimed most of it. Water is already ankle-deep and rising.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.dry-ledge.Title
data.value: Above the Waterline

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.dry-ledge.Body
data.value: Behind a curtain of mineral deposits is a narrow mason's ledge. It keeps you above the coldest water and passes three old tide marks cut into the wall. The highest is only a handspan above the current surface.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.cold-crossing.Title
data.value: Black Water

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.cold-crossing.Body
data.value: The water reaches your waist before the floor rises again. Cold punches the air from your lungs. By the far side your clothes are heavy and your fingers refuse fine work.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.fork-below.Title
data.value: Two Ways Down

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.fork-below.Body
data.value: The cavern divides. Left, fresh boot marks lead through a reinforced tunnel. Right, old chapel carvings descend toward the sound of water striking bronze. Somewhere ahead, a human voice coughs once.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-alive.Title
data.value: Tomas Rook

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-alive.Body
data.value: You find Tomas chained to an iron ring above the tide line, bruised, dehydrated and very much alive. Varro's men caught him photographing the old inscriptions. He laughs once when he sees you. 'Tell Nell I was right first. Then you can rescue me.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-cost.Title
data.value: The Ring Gives Last

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-cost.Body
data.value: The old fastening finally tears free, but not cleanly. Stone and iron rake across your arm as Tomas falls forward. You have him — and a bleeding wound to carry deeper.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-freed.Title
data.value: The Witness

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tomas-freed.Body
data.value: Tomas can walk. More importantly, he knows what Varro's people were doing: they were trying to raise a bronze bell from the drowned chapel before spring tide exposed the chamber to outsiders. Each attempt made the ringing worse. Tomas found the original passenger manifest in a sealed reliquary and hid it before they caught him.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.manifest-route.Title
data.value: The Reliquary Path

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.manifest-route.Body
data.value: Tomas points toward the old chapel route. The manifest is behind a saint's niche above the flooded gallery. 'If the bell rings while you're in there, don't listen for words,' he warns. 'It knows which name hurts.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.flooded-gallery.Title
data.value: The Drowned Procession

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.flooded-gallery.Body
data.value: Stone saints stand waist-deep in seawater along the gallery. Their faces have been chiseled away. When the distant bell shifts in the current, eleven pale reflections appear between them although there are only ten statues.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.dread-gallery.Title
data.value: The Name in Your Voice

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.dread-gallery.Body
data.value: One reflection turns toward you and speaks in your own voice. For several breaths you cannot remember why you came here, only that the water would be warmer if you stopped resisting it.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.saints-niche.Title
data.value: The Original Manifest

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.saints-niche.Body
data.value: Behind a cracked statue of Saint Orra is a copper cylinder wrapped in oilskin. Inside lies the original Saint Marrow passenger manifest. Eleven names marked 'survivors landed at Greyhaven' were later crossed through in a different hand. The copied village record called those same people lost at sea.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.truth-of-marow.Title
data.value: What Greyhaven Did

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.truth-of-marow.Body
data.value: The remaining papers complete the crime. Seventy years ago four village families extinguished the lighthouse to wreck Saint Marrow and steal its payroll chest. Eleven passengers survived the rocks. Greyhaven's conspirators killed them in the lower chapel, rewrote the records and used the stolen gold to rebuild the harbor. The bell was sunk with the bodies.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-below.Title
data.value: Varro Comes Below

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-below.Body
data.value: Lanterns appear behind you. Captain Varro enters the gallery with two dockhands and no weapon drawn. 'My grandfather told me enough to hate him,' he says. 'I kept the tunnels quiet because exposing this destroys people who had no part in it. I was moving the bell before someone else found it. That was my mistake.'

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-honest.Title
data.value: A Guilty Man, Not That Crime

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.varro-honest.Body
data.value: Varro is hiding plenty — smuggling, bribery, the imprisonment of Tomas — but not this. He did not cause the bell's return and he is genuinely afraid that moving it again will kill someone. His shame is inherited; his recent crimes are entirely his own.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bell-threshold.Title
data.value: The Door beneath the Tide

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bell-threshold.Body
data.value: A round bronze door seals the final chamber. Eleven empty nameplates ring its frame. The tide key fits its center. Without the key, a corroded wheel can still be forced. Water curls around your boots and rises another finger-width.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tide-crash.Title
data.value: High Water

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.tide-crash.Body
data.value: The wheel breaks loose at the same moment a surge fills the gallery. The door opens, but the return route disappears beneath black water. Whatever ending waits here, you will have to earn your way back to the surface.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bell-chamber.Title
data.value: Act V — The Bell Beneath

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.bell-chamber.Body
data.value: The chamber is larger than the chapel above it should allow. A bronze ship's bell hangs half-submerged from a stone arch, suspended by chains green with age. Beneath it lies the broken payroll chest. Around the walls, eleven shallow graves have been opened by the tide. When you enter, the bell swings without being touched.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.gold-chest.Title
data.value: Greyhaven's Foundation

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.gold-chest.Body
data.value: Most of the Saint Marrow gold vanished generations ago, but enough remains beneath the collapsed chest to change a life. No ghost guards it. No trap protects it. The temptation is entirely ordinary.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.eleven-voices.Title
data.value: Eleven Names

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.eleven-voices.Body
data.value: The bell tolls once. This close, the sound does not strike your ears; it passes through bone. Eleven voices speak, not asking for vengeance, only repeating names that Greyhaven erased. The dead do not want the village destroyed. They want to have existed.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.names-restored.Title
data.value: The Debt

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.names-restored.Body
data.value: As each name is spoken, one grave fills with still water instead of churning foam. The final voice does not fade. It asks for the rite that was started and abandoned seventy years ago: name the dead, return the stolen record, toll the bell once for each life, and let Greyhaven hear what it built itself upon.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.rite-preparation.Title
data.value: A Bell for Each Name

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.rite-preparation.Body
data.value: The rite needs no miracle beyond honesty. Eleven names. Eleven tolls. Rowan's unfinished notation supplies the words if you understood it; Tomas's manifest supplies the truth. Above you, Greyhaven waits inside its fog.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.break-bell-choice.Title
data.value: Bronze and Bone

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.break-bell-choice.Body
data.value: Destroying the bell will end its call, but it will also end the only force compelling Greyhaven to look at the old crime. The chains can be cut and the bell dropped into the deepest fissure where even spring tide cannot reach it.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.escape-with-truth.Title
data.value: The Water Rises

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.escape-with-truth.Body
data.value: With the manifest protected beneath your coat, you turn for the surface. The tide has claimed part of the return route. Behind you the bell continues its slow impossible swing. Ahead, Greyhaven's lights are only a pale suggestion through rock and water.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.village-reckoning.Title
data.value: Greyhaven Hears

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.village-reckoning.Body
data.value: Dawn finds the village gathered inside Saint Orra's. Tomas stands beside Nell if you rescued him. Rowan places the original manifest on the altar. Varro remains at the back, expression unreadable. You can still decide how much of the truth belongs to everyone.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.hub-tomas
data.value: Search Tomas Rook's room.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.hub-chapel
data.value: Visit Father Rowan at Saint Orra's.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.hub-lighthouse
data.value: Climb to the abandoned lighthouse.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.hub-harbor
data.value: Investigate Captain Varro's warehouse.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.hub-enough
data.value: Lay out the evidence you have gathered.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.ask-nell-room
data.value: Ask Nell what Tomas had been researching.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.take-page
data.value: Take the altered manifest page.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.record-families
data.value: Add the family pattern to your notes.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.ask-original
data.value: Ask where an original might have survived.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.mark-false-deaths
data.value: Mark the discrepancy.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.tell-rowan
data.value: Show Rowan what the marks mean.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.use-rope-crypt
data.value: Use rope to reach the side passage.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.leave-crypt
data.value: Do not force the old foundation yet.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.note-recess
data.value: Record the bell-shaped recess and return upstairs.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.take-key
data.value: Take the rusted tide key.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.continue-tower
data.value: Continue straight to the tower.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.ask-elias
data.value: Ask what is below the lighthouse.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.take-log-copy
data.value: Ask Elias for the page.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.take-drain
data.value: Use the drainage arch.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.mark-drain
data.value: Do not enter yet; mark it as a route below the lighthouse.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.trace-line
data.value: Trace the line as far as you safely can.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.keep-lamp
data.value: Take the blue salt-lantern and return to town.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.watch-warehouse
data.value: Watch where the night workers carry crates.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.record-cart
data.value: Record the false service route.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.take-evidence
data.value: Copy the payments and take the brass service key.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.ask-mara-varro
data.value: Ask Mara where Varro goes when he wants privacy.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.confront-varro
data.value: Go directly to Captain Varro.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.accept-invitation
data.value: Accept the invitation.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.go-game
data.value: Meet him tonight.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.approach-varro-game
data.value: Sit across from Captain Varro.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.approach-bram-game
data.value: Ask Bram about the bone dice.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.play-varro

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.city-threads.Title
data.value: Three Addresses in the Rain

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.city-threads.Location
data.value: Calder Street · Investigation routes

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.city-threads.Body
data.value: The notebook stays open beneath the awning of an all-night chemist. Hotel facts on the left; people who would rather they stayed facts without explanations on the right. Every address is a different kind of risk. None requires you to believe Evelyn's version of her husband. You can revisit a thread while it still has something to offer; the docks remain open when you are ready to follow the freight route.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.evelyn-apartment.Title
data.value: The Accounts She Kept

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.evelyn-apartment.Location
data.value: Vane apartment · Calder Heights

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.evelyn-apartment.Body
data.value: Evelyn has taken off the expensive earrings. They sit beside an unpaid electricity bill, absurdly small next to the house around them. Arthur's redevelopment company has been buying condemned blocks through the casino, she says. She signed an invitation for him because Moretti would no longer take his calls. She knew about the debts. She did not know where the families evicted from those blocks were meant to go. When you do not offer absolution, she gives you the invitation and two ferry berths she had booked before she hired you.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hotel-cabinet.Title
data.value: Behind the Guest Wallpaper

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hotel-cabinet.Location
data.value: Mirabelle · Room 306 service cabinet

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hotel-cabinet.Body
data.value: The duplicate turns in a second, smaller lock behind the telephone plate. Inside the service recess is the maintenance clip's mate and a carbon of the erased call sheet. The hotel did not invent the missing minutes; someone borrowed its machinery. You wrap the metal in your handkerchief before closing the cabinet. This is the kind of evidence a man can lose simply by trusting the wrong desk.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.night-chemist.Title
data.value: Tools, Not Miracles

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.night-chemist.Location
data.value: All-night chemist · Wren Street

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.night-chemist.Body
data.value: The chemist has a wartime medical bag under the till and a tray of locksmith's tools that he insists belong to his cousin. He asks no questions about the hour. Prices are written on cardboard; you check your pocket before making a promise. There is no obligation to buy anything. A steady hand or a patient conversation can still open doors a tool would have opened more quietly.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.exchange.Title
data.value: The Operator's Memory

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.exchange.Location
data.value: Central telephone exchange · Night desk

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.exchange.Body
data.value: Nora Finch remembers the cut line. She remembers every man who told her a city's telephone wires were none of her business. Her supervisor filed a private dictation cylinder when the police borrowed a circuit. The call sheet tells her where to look; the bridge clip tells her whose maintenance cabinet was used. Without both, you will have to persuade her to risk searching the private shelf on your word.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.exchange-proof.Title
data.value: A Voice Above the Badge

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.exchange-proof.Location
data.value: Central exchange · Listening booth

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.exchange-proof.Body
data.value: On the cylinder, a man gives an order without raising his voice: move Vane from the hotel, hold him at Municipal Pump House Four, recover the signed book before morning. Nora identifies the private line as Commissioner Rook's office. A voice alone can be disputed; the routing record makes it harder. She gives you both, then takes down the name of an attorney. You thank her by writing it in your notebook instead of promising she will not need one.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.exchange-warning.Title
data.value: The Line Is Listening

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.exchange-warning.Location
data.value: Central exchange · Street exit

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.exchange-warning.Body
data.value: Nora reaches for the shelf, then sees the supervisor in the glass. She cannot do it tonight. At the door she presses a maintenance schedule into your hand: the Mirabelle's borrowed circuit runs along the river. It is a lead, not proof. Across the street an unlit police car starts its engine. You let a tram pass between you before walking away.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-door.Title
data.value: The Lift With No Button

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-door.Location
data.value: Monarch Casino · Private entrance

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-door.Body
data.value: The lift attendant wears gloves too clean for the street outside. Upstairs, a pianist keeps finding the same tired chord. The attendant asks for a name, an invitation, or an explanation he can afford to believe. Through the lift grille you can see a police raincoat hanging beside the house coats. The private room belongs to Moretti. Its visitors apparently have other employers.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-service.Title
data.value: The House Has a Back Door

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-service.Location
data.value: Monarch Casino · Service stairs

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-service.Body
data.value: The lift stays downstairs. On your way out, a porter mistakes you for the man collecting the private room's laundry. You carry the basket far enough to learn the route, set it down outside the pantry, and arrive upstairs with a pair of house eyes already on you. Access has a price even when nobody asks for money.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-floor.Title
data.value: The Ivory Room

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-floor.Location
data.value: Monarch Casino · Upper salon

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-floor.Body
data.value: The tables are smaller than the debts made around them. Vincent Moretti sits where he can see both exits. Lena Vale sings without looking at the police raincoat on the rack. A cashier closes a book whenever a guest changes tables. You can speak to more than one of them, but every finished conversation changes the way the others look at you.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti.Title
data.value: A Debt With the Wrong Creditor

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti.Location
data.value: Ivory Room · Moretti's booth

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti.Body
data.value: Moretti studies your coat before he studies your face. Arthur was not gambling away the company, he says. He was buying back a ledger he had already signed. Rook wanted the book because it listed the compensation paid for empty streets that had still been full of people. Moretti offers the location of a municipal transfer for the name of your client. You can refuse the trade. The bent cufflink may make a more useful introduction.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti-truth.Title
data.value: Municipal Property

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti-truth.Location
data.value: Ivory Room · Moretti's booth

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti-truth.Body
data.value: The eagle is a retirement-service clasp issued to senior officers, not a casino ornament. Moretti has seen Rook wear it. His driver also saw Hale escort Vane from the hotel alive. 'An escort is not the same thing as an arrest,' he says. Pump House Four is where the city's confiscated freight waits for morning paperwork. Moretti gives you an address because an honest ledger would ruin Rook before it ruined him. That is a motive to help, and a reason not to trust him with the original.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti-price.Title
data.value: The Name on the Envelope

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti-price.Location
data.value: Ivory Room · Moretti's booth

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti-price.Body
data.value: Moretti lets the silence do the bargaining. You decline to buy an address with Evelyn's name. On the way out his man deliberately leaves a freight schedule face up: Municipal Pump House Four, before dawn. The gift is a reminder that he knows which direction you will walk. Somewhere behind you, a telephone starts to ring.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.lena.Title
data.value: The Woman Outside the Photograph

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.lena.Location
data.value: Ivory Room · Piano alcove

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.lena.Body
data.value: Lena Vale folds her sheet music very carefully when you say Arthur's name. She says he was frightened, not drunk, when he left the Mirabelle. She does not say how she knows. One glove hangs out of her evening bag. If she is the missing figure in the photograph, she has already watched someone erase her once.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.lena-trust.Title
data.value: An Escort, Not an Arrest

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.lena-trust.Location
data.value: Monarch Casino · Back balcony

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.lena-trust.Body
data.value: Lena is Hale's sister. Arthur asked her to carry a book to prosecutor Ada Mercer, then panicked when Rook arrived. Hale came to protect Lena, she says; afterward he obeyed Rook's order to move Arthur. Both things can be true. The full photograph belongs to a man on the docks who makes passport pictures. Lena agrees to meet you there. You do not ask her to trust a badge. You give her an address with two exits.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.lena-leaves.Title
data.value: The Empty Piano Stool

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.lena-leaves.Location
data.value: Ivory Room · Piano alcove

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.lena-leaves.Body
data.value: You ask one question too many before offering her anything solid. Lena excuses herself. A waiter tells you she buys her photographs on the river and means it as a kindness; another man hears him. You have a direction to follow, but not the trust that would have made it safer for her.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cashier.Title
data.value: The Retained Copy

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cashier.Location
data.value: Ivory Room · Cashier's rail

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cashier.Body
data.value: The cashier is balancing freight costs against police entertainment expenses. It is a poor place to hide a transfer, unless the people reading it already agree not to see it. A carbon sheet protrudes beneath the blotter. Taking it openly would make a scene. Making the cashier explain the numbers might make a better one.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.carbon-found.Title
data.value: Paper Remembers

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.carbon-found.Location
data.value: Ivory Room · Cloakroom

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.carbon-found.Body
data.value: The carbon names Pump House Four, a police escort, and a crate registered as reclaimed furniture. Under the typed inventory is a handwritten correction: A. Vane, alive. It is not enough to convict anyone. It is enough to contradict the story that Arthur simply walked away. You fold it along the old crease, not through the signature.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cashier-warning.Title
data.value: House Security

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cashier-warning.Location
data.value: Ivory Room · Cashier's rail

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cashier-warning.Body
data.value: The cashier puts a hand on the carbon before yours reaches it. He says Pump House Four clearly enough for the room to hear, then asks you to leave his desk. You keep the destination. He keeps the proof. A man near the lift writes down the color of your coat.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.dock-approach.Title
data.value: Favors and Knives

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.dock-approach.Location
data.value: River district · Loading gates

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.dock-approach.Body
data.value: The Mirabelle van stops beside a warehouse with municipal locks and private guards. Further downriver a pump beats against its own broken rhythm. The photographer's lamp is the only warm window between them. There is still time to learn who moved Arthur, find what they were carrying, or reach the man himself. Nobody here is going to ask whether you have a warrant until after they have seen whether you are alone.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.warehouse-door.Title
data.value: A Municipal Lock

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.warehouse-door.Location
data.value: River warehouse · Dispatch office

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.warehouse-door.Body
data.value: Behind the wired glass a dispatch lamp burns over a stack of retained carbons. There is nobody at the desk. A police seal has been put over the door without covering the latch, a useful distinction for a locksmith and a prosecutor. You can spend the tools, risk the noise, or preserve the seal and walk away.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.warehouse-carbon.Title
data.value: Furniture With a Pulse

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.warehouse-carbon.Location
data.value: Dispatch office · Filing shelf

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.warehouse-carbon.Body
data.value: The warehouse copy says what the casino copy only hints at. A man listed as furniture was held for a transfer signed E. Rook. The dispatcher's notebook puts Hale in the escort car, with Lena Vale ordered to follow. Neither was booked into a cell. Beneath the schedule is a requisition for field dressings. You take a sealed packet from the shelf and leave the rest where a night worker can find them.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.warehouse-seen.Title
data.value: A Light Across the Yard

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.warehouse-seen.Location
data.value: Warehouse · Loading yard

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.warehouse-seen.Body
data.value: The latch gives a short metallic cry. A guard's lamp turns toward the dispatch window. You back out before the seal tears and lose him between two freight cars. The route to the pump house is painted on a municipal sign; that much nobody could hide. The dispatch evidence will have to stay where it is.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.photographer.Title
data.value: The Half They Cut Away

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.photographer.Location
data.value: River district · Bell's photographic studio

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.photographer.Body
data.value: Otto Bell still has the negative. He keeps other people's secrets in numbered envelopes and charges for paper, he tells you, not silence. On his contact sheet Hale stands beside Vane and Lena, holding a coat over the book under Arthur's arm. The picture places him there. It does not tell you whose orders he obeyed afterward.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.negative-found.Title
data.value: A Witness Made of Silver

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.negative-found.Location
data.value: Bell's studio · Red-lit workroom

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.negative-found.Body
data.value: Bell marks the print from the dated plate register, then slides the uncut negative into a dry sleeve. The register dates the photograph to the winter visits Evelyn had omitted. It places Lena, Hale and Vane outside the Monarch together; it does not put them in room 306. Bell offers to testify to the photograph, not to what you wish it meant. That is better than a cooperative liar.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.photo-refused.Title
data.value: No More Credit

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.photo-refused.Location
data.value: Bell's studio · Street door

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.photo-refused.Body
data.value: Bell has extended enough credit to men who said a story would pay them. He locks the envelope away. Before the bolt closes he tells you Lena came through the studio and went toward the pump house. She was walking quickly, but not with the man behind her. You leave the negative and follow the living lead.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.pump-approach.Title
data.value: Water Under the City

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.pump-approach.Location
data.value: Municipal Pump House Four

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.pump-approach.Body
data.value: A service door stands open over black water. Arthur Vane is inside, one hand pressed hard beneath his coat. Lena is keeping a freight trolley between him and the armed men beyond the pump. The night watchman waves you away, then sees the street behind you and decides he would rather be somewhere else. Getting them out will require a route the guards cannot control.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.pump-pursuit.Title
data.value: The Price of an Exit

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.pump-pursuit.Location
data.value: Pump house · Flood channel

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.pump-pursuit.Body
data.value: The guard fires into the gate, not into the dark beyond it. You keep the trolley low while Lena pulls. Brick dust stings your face and somebody loses a shoe in the water. Arthur is breathing when you reach the far culvert, but his hand has slipped from the wound. Escape has bought a few minutes. It has not bought him a doctor.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.wounded-vane.Title
data.value: A Man, Not an Exhibit

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.wounded-vane.Location
data.value: Flood channel · Dry maintenance landing

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.wounded-vane.Body
data.value: Arthur tries to tell you where the ledger is. Lena tells him to save his breath, and you make room for both instructions. His wound needs pressure and clean cloth. In the distance the pump starts again, making the landing tremble. Whatever he signed, he is still a man on a cold floor. You choose what you can do for that man before deciding what his testimony is worth.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.safehouse.Title
data.value: What He Signed

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.safehouse.Location
data.value: Bell's studio · Upstairs room

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.safehouse.Body
data.value: The doctor arrives through the rear door. Arthur survives long enough to admit what the ledger contains: compensation stolen from the families his company evicted, police payments made to keep the blocks quiet, and his own signature authorizing both. He tried to sell the book back before he tried to expose it. Lena will sign what she saw, provided her address stays out of the public file. Bringing him back has not made him innocent. It has given him the chance to stop making other people carry his guilt.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.last-witness.Title
data.value: The Witness Who Walks

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.last-witness.Location
data.value: River district · Ambulance call box

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.last-witness.Body
data.value: You leave the precise address with the dispatcher and hear an ambulance engine before you turn the corner. You cannot know whether it will reach Arthur before Rook's men do. Lena can walk, and tonight that is the difference you can still make. In Bell's upstairs room she dictates what she saw and signs beneath it. The empty space where Arthur's signature might have gone stays empty.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.precinct.Title
data.value: The Badge Has Teeth

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.precinct.Location
data.value: Central precinct · Public counter

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.precinct.Body
data.value: At six in the morning the precinct smells of wet wool and yesterday's coffee. Hale is at a desk he has not slept behind. The archive door carries a seal from Rook's office. You can make Hale look at a photograph, try the records route yourself, or demand an interview with the commissioner. Leaving the docks did not close the case. It brought the case into the building that has been editing it.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-office.Title
data.value: A Brother in Uniform

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-office.Location
data.value: Precinct · Hale's office

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-office.Body
data.value: Hale leaves the door open. He says it is for your protection, then looks at the corridor as though protection has become an awkward word. His coat is still damp at the cuffs. You have enough to accuse him of moving Arthur, but accusation and explanation are different tools. If the photograph means what Lena said it means, this is the point at which you find out whether he is prepared to put his name under it.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-confession.Title
data.value: An Order Is Still a Choice

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-confession.Location
data.value: Precinct · Hale's office

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-confession.Body
data.value: Hale admits he moved Vane on Rook's order. He thought the alternative was Lena being booked as an accomplice, and he chose the explanation he could live with for one more hour. The original ledger is in the municipal impound archive; Rook meant to replace its signed pages. Hale will countersign Lena's account and send a clerk to preserve the register. He asks whether that makes him safe. You tell him it makes him a witness. He does not ask again.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-silence.Title
data.value: The Door He Leaves Open

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-silence.Location
data.value: Precinct · Corridor

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-silence.Body
data.value: Hale answers in procedure until the words have no useful edges left. As you stand, he leaves an archive requisition where you can see it. Vane's book has been impounded, not destroyed. If you want his signature beside an allegation, you will need something stronger than the right suspicion.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.archive-door.Title
data.value: The Record That Survived

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.archive-door.Location
data.value: Precinct · Municipal impound archive

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.archive-door.Body
data.value: The clerk has a cancellation order but no replacement entry. That distinction can be made to matter. Hale's countersignature would stop the cancellation. The exchange recording or the freight carbon would force the clerk to preserve a disputed exhibit. Without a document, you can try the service door or your knowledge of the procedure the commissioner has skipped.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.signed-book.Title
data.value: Every Empty House

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.signed-book.Location
data.value: Municipal archive · Exhibit shelf

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.signed-book.Body
data.value: The ledger weighs less than the people in it. Row after row lists compensation that never reached the tenants, emergency removals paid to officers who were never assigned, and invoices passed through Moretti's accounts. Arthur signed the transfers. Rook signed the protection orders. You copy the exhibit number before taking custody. It is the first time tonight the city's own paper has admitted the shape of the crime.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.archive-refusal.Title
data.value: The Seal Wins For Now

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.archive-refusal.Location
data.value: Precinct · Archive counter

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.archive-refusal.Body
data.value: The clerk asks for the section you cannot quite remember. By the time you have reconstructed it, Rook's office has called. The exhibit remains in storage, but you will not get another hearing on the same argument this morning. You write down the refusal, the time, and the clerk's name. They belong in the case too, even if they are not the book.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.rook-office.Title
data.value: The Man Who Calls It Order

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.rook-office.Location
data.value: Commissioner's office · Closed blinds

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.rook-office.Body
data.value: Commissioner Rook does not deny that people were paid. He calls them relocation costs. He calls Arthur a distressed debtor and Hale a man who needs supervision. He calls you a person with a future, which is the first threat he has delivered plainly. A typed conclusion waits on his desk: Hale acted alone. Beside it is an envelope thick enough to make the conclusion worth signing.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.rook-terms.Title
data.value: The Offered Version

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.rook-terms.Location
data.value: Commissioner's office · Guest chair

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.rook-terms.Body
data.value: Rook wants Hale named as the man who took Vane, the ledger handed over if you have it, and Lena's whereabouts left off the public record. In return you get a fee and the assurance that Evelyn will be allowed to leave. He has confused a witness's safety with the price of her silence. You can still leave with the offer unwritten. Keeping it as an option changes what kind of ending you are prepared to choose.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.editor.Title
data.value: Everyone Owes Someone

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.editor.Location
data.value: The Calder Gazette · Night desk

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.editor.Body
data.value: Ruth Bell makes you put the papers on a table before she listens to the story. A ledger can be stolen. A voice can be imitated. A witness can be frightened into silence. Put them beside an independent freight record or a dated photograph, and the city has to work much harder to pretend nothing happened. She will set type for an accountable story, not a convenient villain. You still have time to protect the witness, preserve a copy, or decide to sell the truth to somebody who already knows it.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.protected-copy.Title
data.value: Two Envelopes

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.protected-copy.Location
data.value: Gazette · Composing room

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.protected-copy.Body
data.value: Ruth makes one photographic copy for the paper and another for the attorney who will receive the depositions. You number the pages before sealing either envelope. A duplicate does not make witnesses immortal or turn an accusation into a conviction. It does mean that taking the original off you will no longer take the whole case. In the window the first pale seam of morning appears behind the rain.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-transfer.Title
data.value: An Address Worth Keeping

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-transfer.Location
data.value: Bell's studio · Rear stairs

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-transfer.Body
data.value: A car is waiting across from the studio. You do not use the front door. Ruth's attorney has arranged a room above a clinic where the register will use the court's reference rather than Lena's name. If Hale has agreed to testify, he arrives on foot with no badge visible. The safest promise you can give either of them is a specific route, a specific person at the far end, and no public address in tomorrow's paper.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-decoy.Title
data.value: The Coat They Follow

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-decoy.Location
data.value: Calder Street · Tram shelter

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-decoy.Body
data.value: The watcher sees your first turn. You lend your coat to a willing press runner and make sure he takes the tram with a conductor on board. The watcher follows the color, not the face. By the time he realizes what has happened, Lena is upstairs at the clinic. Your own walk back takes longer and costs you a bruised shoulder. It is still the better bargain.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-secured.Title
data.value: A Name Under Protection

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-secured.Location
data.value: Gazette · Attorney's telephone

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-secured.Body
data.value: The attorney confirms the arrival using the phrase you agreed, then reads back the statement's exhibit number. It is not an ending yet. It is a living person the morning cannot quietly misplace. Ruth leaves the witness's address out of the type and keeps the accusation in.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti-offer.Title
data.value: A Quiet Balance

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti-offer.Location
data.value: Gazette alley · Moretti's car

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.moretti-offer.Body
data.value: Moretti sends a driver, then comes himself when you will not approach the car. He can get Vane out of the district and stop the men outside Bell's studio. He wants the original ledger, not a promise of friendship. You can make the trade, refuse it, or tell him that independent copies already exist if you have actually made them. Each answer leaves a different person holding the leverage.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.dawn-decision.Title
data.value: Dead Man's Hand

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.dawn-decision.Location
data.value: Calder Gazette · The first edition

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.dawn-decision.Body
data.value: The city at dawn looks less innocent than it does at night. You lay out only what you can substantiate. Rook's orders, Arthur's signatures, Hale's choices, Lena's account: none cancels out the others. Ruth is ready to stop the press if you are still making a case. Moretti's car is waiting at the curb. Beyond it, the ferry horn sounds once. You choose where the truth goes, who carries it, and what you are prepared to leave behind.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.press-proof.Title
data.value: Before the Ink Dries

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.press-proof.Location
data.value: Gazette · Press floor

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.press-proof.Body
data.value: Ruth reads the names back to you. Arthur is in the story as a participant who later tried to withdraw, not as a spotless victim. Hale's testimony appears beside his admission. Lena's address does not appear at all. When Rook calls, the first bundles have already gone to three stations. You cannot promise the editor there will be convictions. You can promise the city will no longer be able to lose the question.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.court-proof.Title
data.value: Exhibit One

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.court-proof.Location
data.value: County courthouse · Mercer's chamber

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.court-proof.Body
data.value: Mercer takes custody under a written receipt and asks you to distinguish what you saw from what you inferred. That slows the telling and improves it. She can seek a sealed order for Lena, subpoena the archive, and ask Hale the question Rook would rather answer for him. Outside, the newspaper sellers are still waiting for a headline. You choose the slower machinery and make it name every piece it takes from you.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.press-ledger.Title
data.value: Names Without Addresses

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.press-ledger.Location
data.value: Gazette · Editor's table

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.press-ledger.Body
data.value: The ledger can sustain an investigation into payments. It cannot, alone, prove every order given in the missing seventeen minutes. Ruth prints exactly that distinction. You keep the frightened people out of the story and leave the missing-person file unresolved where the evidence does not answer it. The headline is smaller than the one you imagined. It is also one you can defend.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.bargain-proof.Title
data.value: The Car at the Curb

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.bargain-proof.Location
data.value: Gazette alley · Moretti's car

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.bargain-proof.Body
data.value: Moretti's men stop watching the studio. A private ambulance receives an unobstructed route out of the river district. The ledger has changed hands; the facts have not. If copies remain elsewhere, Moretti knows his new insurance is not exclusive. He calls the arrangement peace. You write settlement in the notebook and leave enough space beneath it for the interest.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ferry-proof.Title
data.value: Two Berths

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ferry-proof.Location
data.value: Pier Seven · Departure gangway

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ferry-proof.Body
data.value: Arthur boards with a physician's note under his coat and Evelyn's hand locked around his wrist. The ticket gets them through a gate no argument would have opened. He asks what you will tell the police. You tell him leaving a city does not unsign a ledger. The ferry pulls away before he can decide whether that is a warning or the first honest thing anyone has said to him tonight.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.blackmail-proof.Title
data.value: The Vacant Chair

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.blackmail-proof.Location
data.value: Commissioner's office · Morning light

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.blackmail-proof.Body
data.value: You do not hand Rook the ledger. You let him see the page with his signature and tell him where your next copy will go if the arrangement changes. He moves the envelope toward you. For the first time he uses your name as though it belongs on a door. Outside, a clerk is being told that an independent investigator has endorsed the commissioner's account. The city has found another person who can explain its costs.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ashes-proof.Title
data.value: An Original Burns Once

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ashes-proof.Location
data.value: Vane apartment · Cold fireplace

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ashes-proof.Body
data.value: Evelyn does not look away while the signed pages curl. You made no protected duplicate. The signatures are gone in a way testimony may never repair. Perhaps you call it mercy for a frightened household; perhaps you admit you have decided which households are allowed to keep their names off the record. In the hearth one brass staple survives longer than the paper it held.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.fallguy-proof.Title
data.value: The Convenient Arrest

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.fallguy-proof.Location
data.value: Central precinct · Complaint desk

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.fallguy-proof.Body
data.value: Hale did move Vane. A narrow complaint can say so truthfully while leaving out the man who gave the order and the money that paid for the room. Rook accepts the accusation with the gravity of someone attending a funeral he arranged. You watch Hale read it. He asks whether Lena will be safe. The desk sergeant says that is a separate matter.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-proof.Title
data.value: A Living Name

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-proof.Location
data.value: Clinic · Side entrance

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.witness-proof.Body
data.value: The file is not strong enough to put the whole city on trial. The person behind the clinic door is still alive because you went to the river instead of waiting for permission. You leave the affidavit with the attorney and keep a copy of the witness's preferred contact arrangement. You have not solved every part of the case. You refuse to let that make the part you did save disappear.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cold-proof.Title
data.value: The Empty Line

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cold-proof.Location
data.value: Private office · Morning rain

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cold-proof.Body
data.value: Back at the office, you write the facts in ink and the suspicions in pencil. There is not enough to name the whole crime, and naming a smaller one for convenience would help whoever designed it. Evelyn gets an honest account of what you know. The city gets no reassuring conclusion from you. You put the unanswered question at the front of the file where tomorrow's hand will find it first.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-open-record.Title
data.value: The Open Record

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-open-record.Body
data.value: Three editions, a sealed deposition and a preserved archive make the Vane affair public. Rook faces a corruption inquiry; Arthur faces his own signed accounts. Lena remains under protection. Nobody calls the city clean. It has become harder for it to pretend the dirt belongs to only one man.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-open-record.Location
data.value: Calder City · After dawn

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-court.Title
data.value: Exhibit One

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-court.Body
data.value: The prosecutor opens proceedings under an exhibit number that cannot be erased from a hotel call sheet. A protected witness and the original ledger survive to be challenged in court. The verdict is not yours to write. Getting the right people into a room where questions must be answered is.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-court.Location
data.value: Calder City · After dawn

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-paper-trail.Title
data.value: The Paper Trail

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-paper-trail.Body
data.value: The compensation scandal reaches the front page with its limits stated plainly. The payments are established; the disappearance remains contested. Ruth keeps the duplicate. You keep the unresolved timeline. A smaller honest case leaves room for the next piece of truth.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-paper-trail.Location
data.value: Calder City · After dawn

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-house-credit.Title
data.value: House Credit

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-house-credit.Body
data.value: The immediate danger recedes under Moretti's protection. He now holds the original record of the city's debts, including one you have incurred yourself. The casino is quieter by morning. The ledger is still a weapon, and it is no longer in your hands.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-house-credit.Location
data.value: Calder City · After dawn

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-two-berths.Title
data.value: Two Berths Out

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-two-berths.Body
data.value: Arthur and Evelyn leave on the morning ferry. Survival has been purchased; innocence has not. The pages and statements you retained remain in your file, beyond the reach of the people on the boat. Somewhere downstream, Arthur will have to decide whether being alive is another chance to answer or another chance to run.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-two-berths.Location
data.value: Calder City · After dawn

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-new-creditor.Title
data.value: The New Creditor

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-new-creditor.Body
data.value: You become the person Rook must consult before he spends the city's silence. The families in the ledger receive neither their money nor their names back. The case has made you powerful in precisely the way it first taught you to distrust.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-new-creditor.Location
data.value: Calder City · After dawn

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-ashes.Title
data.value: The Cost of Mercy

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-ashes.Body
data.value: The original signatures are ash and there is no independent duplicate. Evelyn has the private closure she wanted. The tenants whose compensation paid for that closure have not been asked. You will remember the sound of the grate whenever another client tells you a matter should remain in the family.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-ashes.Location
data.value: Calder City · After dawn

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-fallguy.Title
data.value: The Smaller Crime

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-fallguy.Body
data.value: Hale is suspended while Rook announces an independent investigation. The accusation contains a fact and omits its cause. There is enough truth in the file to make the lie respectable, which is why the commissioner is so pleased to have received it.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-fallguy.Location
data.value: Calder City · After dawn

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-living-witness.Title
data.value: A Living Witness

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-living-witness.Body
data.value: The city's full account remains unfinished. One person who was meant to disappear has a lawyer, an address kept off the public record and another morning. You leave the unanswered case on the desk without calling that survival a consolation prize.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-living-witness.Location
data.value: Calder City · After dawn

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-open-file.Title
data.value: The File Stays Open

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-open-file.Body
data.value: No convenient suspect is offered up to cover the gaps. The missing proof remains missing, and your notes make that plain. A detective's obligation is sometimes to leave an honest question where a powerful man wanted a comfortable answer.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ending-open-file.Location
data.value: Calder City · After dawn

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.leave-room
data.value: Bag the evidence and decide which thread to follow first.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.return-to-room
data.value: Return to the room. There may be more to find.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.continue-investigation
data.value: Open your notebook and choose the next address.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.visit-evelyn
data.value: Revisit Evelyn and ask what Arthur was buying with his casino debts.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.visit-ivory
data.value: Go upstairs at the Monarch Casino.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.visit-exchange
data.value: Visit the telephone exchange before the operator leaves.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.visit-cabinet
data.value: Use the duplicate key on room 306's service cabinet.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.visit-supplies
data.value: Buy practical tools at the all-night chemist.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.follow-freight
data.value: Follow the Mirabelle's overnight service van to the river warehouses.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.evelyn-trust
data.value: Promise to bring Arthur back to answer for himself, rather than promise innocence.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.evelyn-distance
data.value: Tell her the evidence will decide what happens to him.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.cabinet-return
data.value: Take the clip and call-sheet copy to your next lead.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.buy-picks
data.value: Buy the narrow lockpick roll for six coins.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.buy-dressing
data.value: Buy a sealed field dressing for four coins.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.leave-chemist
data.value: Close your wallet and return to the investigation.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.patch-call
data.value: Lay out the call-sheet copy and bridge clip so Nora can reconstruct the circuit.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ask-nora
data.value: Ask Nora to search the private shelf and let you hear what the city recorded.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.leave-exchange
data.value: Leave the operator out of it and follow another thread.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.exchange-return
data.value: Protect Nora's name and take the recording.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.exchange-warning-return
data.value: Keep moving. The river is the next place to look.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.show-pass
data.value: Present Evelyn's invitation and let the lift take you up.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.talk-upstairs
data.value: Become the kind of guest the attendant expects to see.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ivory-retreat
data.value: Do not force the door. Return to the street.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.service-to-floor
data.value: Walk into the room as though you have already been admitted.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ask-moretti
data.value: Ask Moretti about Vane's last debt.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ask-lena
data.value: Wait for Lena's set to end and approach the piano.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.watch-cashier
data.value: Follow the cashier's freight receipts rather than the cards.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.leave-ivory
data.value: Leave by the front lift with what you have learned.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.show-cufflink
data.value: Show him the eagle stamped under the cufflink's hinge.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.read-moretti
data.value: Make him explain why a police commissioner would need a casino's freight van.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.moretti-refuse
data.value: Refuse to name the client and leave his booth.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.moretti-back
data.value: Write down the address without giving him a promise.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.moretti-price-back
data.value: Take the lead, and remember it was planted.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.show-photo
data.value: Show Lena the torn photograph and ask for her version before naming a suspect.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.reassure-lena
data.value: Offer a way out of the room without demanding testimony first.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.lena-trust-back
data.value: Tell her to use the river entrance and keep her name out of your notes.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.lena-leaves-back
data.value: Leave her a quiet route out, even if she will not use it yet.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.lift-carbon
data.value: Slip the freight carbon out while he counts the table float.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.audit-carbon
data.value: Ask why municipal freight is being billed to private gaming accounts.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.carbon-back
data.value: Keep the carbon dry and return to the room.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.cashier-warning-back
data.value: Return to the room before it becomes an escort.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.dock-office
data.value: Search the warehouse dispatch office.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.dock-photo
data.value: Visit the passport photographer and ask for the uncut image.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.dock-rescue
data.value: Find the pump house and reach Vane before the morning transfer.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.dock-badge
data.value: Take what you have to Hale's precinct and make the city answer on paper.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.pick-warehouse
data.value: Use the lockpick roll; sacrifice a fine pick to lift the sealed latch.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.force-warehouse
data.value: Open the latch without disturbing the paper seal.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.leave-warehouse
data.value: Leave the seal intact and try another route.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.warehouse-back
data.value: Take the retained carbon and return to the river.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.warehouse-seen-back
data.value: Keep the destination and leave the guarded office behind.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.buy-negative
data.value: Pay three coins for the original negative and a dated print.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.credit-negative
data.value: Ask Bell to put the cost on your account and the date on the print.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.photo-leave
data.value: Do not take the negative. Return to the docks.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.negative-back
data.value: Keep the negative separate from the torn print.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.photo-refused-back
data.value: Return to the river before the trail grows cold.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.pump-quiet
data.value: Bring them out along the maintenance ledge while the pump starts.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.pump-diversion
data.value: Break the yard's alarm glass and lead the guards away from the service door.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.pursuit-treat
data.value: Get him out of the water and see what can still be done.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.dress-vane
data.value: Use the sealed field dressing and keep steady pressure until help can be arranged.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.treat-vane
data.value: Improvise a pressure dressing and stabilize him for the journey.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.summon-ambulance
data.value: Send an anonymous ambulance call and take Lena out before the guards return.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.safehouse-statement
data.value: Take Lena's statement, arrange protection and return to the remaining dock leads.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.last-witness-back
